mission.title: The End of the Beginning
mission.description: Eliminate Machine opposition and steal vital info.

phase.briefing:
I am glad to see that you have decided to take up employment under the powerful Merovingian. With your aid, we will exact punishment against the Machines and Zion operatives.
As you may know, Machines operatives made an assault on one of our bases not long ago. Go to the base and kill all programs. Also recover all electronic data that you find as we simply cannot afford to lose this vital information.

enter.say: There are three pieces of information in total. Collect the data and clear the place of programs.

objective.text: Kill all of the Machine programs
Recover the data from the dead Exiles

phase.briefing: I am sending you the address of a rather important Exile whose job is to watch over items, like the ones you've obtained. Meet with her and she will have further instructions.

enter.say: The contact's name is Clotilde, and try not to keep her waiting! From what I hear, she's not exactly what you would call the patient type ...

objective.text: Put the three data files into the safe
